name: delivery_audit
description: Compare exact planned repository paths with live worktree changes and return fail-soft delivery evidence for bounded repair routing.

repoPath.description: Git checkout whose live worktree changes are compared against the planned paths.

plannedPaths.description: Repository-relative paths the subtask was planned to change. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings; each path must be relative and may not contain '..'.

agentReport.description: Coding agent's own report, used only for evidence (denials, command failures, status) -- never to decide completeness.

denials.description: Sandbox denial messages reported by the agent.

commandFailures.description: Structured command failures reported directly by the agent.

turns.description: Agent turn records; each turn's commands are scanned for a non-zero exit code.

agentCompleted.description: Whether the agent reported it completed.

structured.description: Prior structured report, echoed back as previousReport.

auditAvailable.description: Whether the audit completed successfully (false only when an exception occurred).

complete.description: True when nothing planned was missing and nothing changed was rejected.

plannedPaths.description: Normalized planned paths (empty on audit failure).

actualPaths.description: Paths actually changed in the worktree (empty on audit failure).

missingPaths.description: Planned paths not found among actual changes (empty on audit failure).

rejectedPaths.description: Changed paths rejected as non-vetted (empty on audit failure).

commandFailures.description: Deduplicated structured command failures collected from the agent report.

sandboxDenials.description: Sandbox denial messages reported by the agent.

previousReport.description: Prior structured report echoed back from the agent report.

branch.description: Current branch name in the checkout (best-effort; empty string if it could not be determined).

head.description: Current HEAD commit (best-effort; empty string if it could not be determined).

reason.description: Exception message; present only when auditAvailable is false.
